extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT payable before grant application
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors seeks a £28,000 probate loan to pay inheritance tax on an estate valued at about £549,000 before applying for the grant.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about probate funding on behalf of the executors. We have noted the estate value of around £549,000 and the £28,000 requested towards the inheritance tax liability. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the estate is being administered, the date by which the inheritance tax must be paid, a breakdown of the estate assets and any liabilities, and details of the executors and their instructions. Please also confirm whether any other borrowing or charges are secured against the estate property. A member of our team will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided.
